title: Link 4
description: Link 4: A captivating web-based game of strategic connections! Challenge your wits and strategic prowess as you aim to connect four stones in a row to achieve victory. This addictive game supports all devices, allowing you to play anytime, anywhere. Immerse yourself in two thrilling themes that set the stage for exciting gameplay. Test your skills against the computer with five challenging levels of difficulty, providing endless hours of fun and engaging entertainment. Play Link 4 now and experience the perfect blend of mind-bending tactics and casual gaming, all in one thrilling package!
instructions: Click touch on the board to drop the stones Make the stones for 4 in a row vertically diagonally or horizontally to win
